Output shell completion code for the specified shell (bash, zsh, fish)

Usage: slipway completion [OPTIONS] <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>  The shell to output completion code for [possible values: bash, zsh, fish]

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
